examples.situation_es: Una nave de la Flota Estelar se aproxima a la Zona Neutral Romulana en 2364.
examples.rule: The game presents known consequences but does not remove deliberate player agency.

examples.situation_es: Una nave viaja por espacio bajorano hacia Espacio Profundo 9 en 2369.
examples.rule: Federation operation of the station does not convert the surrounding space into Federation sovereign territory.

examples.rule: Live campaign state always wins after campaign start.
